#3 Heartwood Chamber

Beneath the breast of Dun lies the Heartwood Chamber, hewn within the vastest of natural hollows ever found in the mountain's domain. Suspended above the blistering heart of the Obsidian Forge, its halls reverberate with the slow, echoing hymn of falling water. From all across the Anvils, rainfall and snowmelt are gathered into its embrace, drawn through aqueducts of such scale and precision they are spoken of in hushed reverence. The secrets of their design are warded jealously by the Council of Guilds, sealed in oath and silence.
